a.title: OpenAI’s Dots Are Always-On AI Agents—and Its Answer to Meta’s Muse

b.lede: OpenAI is responding to Meta's buzzy Muse AI with agentic helpers of its own: Dots. During its DevDay keynote on Tuesday, OpenAI announced that Dots will serve as always-on AI assistants that can "do nearly anything" across connected apps in the background while learning your preferences over time.
